summary: By touch, removes one State or Ongoing Effect of the caster's choice (not Cursed), along with others from the same source.

effects.subject: target
effects.note: Caster chooses which one; cannot remove Cursed. Polarity is 'benefit' for the usual use; it can also remove a beneficial State.

effects.subject: target
effects.note: Only the other States and Ongoing Effects from the same source, when the one removed was imposed by an ability with multiple effects.

properties.note: Caster chooses which State or Ongoing Effect is removed.

clarifications.text: Ending a State or Ongoing Effect from an ability with multiple effects also ends all other States and Ongoing Effects from that same source.

open_questions: L1 says Release cannot remove Cursed, but L2 says all other States from the same source also end; the text does not say whether a Cursed imposed by the same multi-effect ability (e.g. Raise Dead's Cursed with its Suppressed) ends too.
